_comment: Golden vectors for the signed BODIES the server verifies. Generated from backend/auth.py (regenerated deliberately for crypto-core 4.0.0: addresses are 96-hex SHA-384 digests, the encryption key an X-Wing key, every digest in a body SHA-384, the key attestation names the address, wrapped keys carry v 4 and the X-Wing alg), asserted by backend/tests/test_signed_bodies.py and by packages/crypto-core/test/byte-compat.test.js. Both sides must build these byte-for-byte or the signature fails; the point of a shared fixture is that neither side can be the one that is right. The inputs are low-entropy stand-ins on purpose — the bodies interpolate them verbatim, so realistic values would only make the vectors unreadable without testing anything more.
